No money from me until behavior is fixed
I am cancelling my Dota Plus subscription and will no longer spend money on Dota 2 events until the current Behavior Score and Communication Score system is fixed.

I also want to get a refund for the rest of already paid 1-year dota plus subscription.

The problems have already been extensively documented in Valve's official GitHub repository:

- https://github.com/ValveSoftware/Dota2-Gameplay/issues/35226
- https://github.com/ValveSoftware/Dota2-Gameplay/issues/33850
- https://github.com/ValveSoftware/Dota2-Gameplay/issues/34303
- https://github.com/ValveSoftware/Dota2-Gameplay/issues/35163

I see no reason to continue financially supporting a game while these issues remain unresolved. I will reconsider my decision only when Valve acknowledges the problems and implements meaningful improvements.

i just wanted to say, ive been doing this since 2 years ago or so, and nothing changed, well ok thats not true
report system has gotten a lot better since it was first implemented, but its surely not because me or a lot more like me stopped spending money on dota 2 altogether

i didnt even stop there at spending money, i made countless new accounts and for a good time being, i used to be as toxic as i possibly could be with those new accounts, i taught everyone how to make new accounts with temp mails and how to use skin mods or actual cheats

still, after 2-3 years, nothing changed, game is still the same crap, report system is ever so slightly better, and people are still playing it, so naturally i realized my best choice is to just forget about dota 2, these days i barely play dota 2 at all, play other games instead whenever i want to spend time on video games

it couldve worked if it was a game like "paladins" which had a limited player count, same thing happened there in 2019, me and people like me stopped spending and game died entirely, but dota 2? yea its not gonna happen, player count is too high that ultimately we are just a drop in the ocean

my best advice is to just forget about it
